stations.title: Theo
stations.say: I wrote these. Why do they fail?

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: Names used where they don't live

stations.title: Packing table
stations.text: A label, a price, a note and a box.

captions: Loops are done. Over the weekend Theo wrote four functions of his own.
One crashes, and an order abroad is marked for hand delivery.
You fix where each name is made and used, in four small tasks.
Now the order abroad gets the right note, its own label and its own box.
Every name lives in its braces, and each function uses what it is given.
